name: DDownload
description: Resolves DDownload links by signing in with the account credentials, or with an API key.

account.secret_hint: Pick how this account signs in. Account credentials is the simple way: enter the DDownload username or e-mail and the password, and rDownloader signs in and keeps the session itself. API key is for an account that should not store a password — paste the key from Account → API; it provides account status and file metadata, and downloads then additionally need a cookie session pasted below.
account.secret_hint_api_key: The key from Account → API. It provides account status and file metadata; downloads run through the cookie session below, because the DDownload API offers no direct links.
account.secret_hint_login: The password of the DDownload account named above. DDownload has begun protecting its login form with a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha, so signing in only works with a configured captcha service, or if the challenge is answered by hand under Captchas. With neither, use API key mode with a pasted cookie session.

codes.ddownload.api_key_required: DDownload link check requires the API key
codes.ddownload.cookie_session_invalid: DDownload cookie session is not signed in - paste a fresh cookie session from a signed-in browser: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.cookie_session_required: DDownload cookie session is missing or contains no cookies for ddownload.com
codes.ddownload.cookie_session_required_for_do: DDownload downloads require a cookie session (browser login); the API key only provides metadata
codes.ddownload.cookie_session_unconfirmed: DDownload did not confirm the cookie session either way - the page was neither signed in nor a guest page; try again later: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.download_session_expired: DDownload accepted the API key, but the cookie session downloads run on has expired - sign in at ddownload.com in a browser and paste a fresh cookie session into this account: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.free_limit_reached: DDownload free download limit reached for this IP address
codes.ddownload.login_blocked: DDownload refused the sign-in from this IP address
codes.ddownload.login_captcha: DDownload's login form is protected by {challenge}, which rDownloader cannot answer. Switch this account to API key mode, or paste a cookie session from a signed-in browser.
codes.ddownload.login_credentials_required: DDownload downloads need either account credentials or an imported cookie session
codes.ddownload.login_failed: DDownload rejected the account's username or password
codes.ddownload.login_form_missing: DDownload's login page did not contain the expected sign-in form: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.login_unavailable: DDownload did not confirm the sign-in: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.no_free_form: DDownload free download form was not found: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.no_free_link: DDownload free download did not yield a file link: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.no_premium_file: DDownload cookie session did not return a premium file: {diagnosis}
codes.ddownload.session_unconfirmed: cookie session not confirmed - the account page was neither signed in nor a guest page
